verdict.rationale: Carta documents its own read APIs for retrieving cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes and fair market values, plus a SQL-queryable data warehouse for funds. These let a user pull data out programmatically as structured responses, but nothing documents a complete, self-serve export of all data in open formats. Community reports also say cancelling requires calls or a meeting with a rep, and that Carta makes it hard to cancel and transfer a cap table elsewhere, which undercuts the 'leave' half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account export, explicit open-format guarantees (e.g. CSV/OCF), coverage of all data types, a self-serve offboarding path, and independent corroboration that migrating out works.
